text.description_html:
PBB B7512H, Bommer Replacement Gravity Door Pivot Hinge with Hold Open

PBB B7512H Gravity Door Pivot with Hold Open is a direct fit replacement for Bommer 7512-H Gravity Door Pivot Hinge with Hold Open. Cast Steel construction pivot hinge for doors up to 30 Inches Wide, 7/8" to 1-5/8" Inches Thick with a Maximum Door Weight of 50 lbs. Plated in corrosion resistant silver zinc.

Hold Open Feature does not require any special installation. Holds door in open position when door is opened at least 90 degrees. To release door simply push door gently.

Also available without the hold open PBB B7512 Pivot Hinge

Specifications of the Gravity Pivot Hinge with Hold Open:

  • Maximum Door Width: 30"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: For Louvered Doors 7/8" to 1-5/8" thick
  • Maximum Door Weight: 50 lbs.
  • Steel Construction
  • Surface Mounted Pivot
  • Double Acting
  • Door weight closes door. No Springs
  • Non-Handed
  • Flat Door Bracket: For doors not less than 7/8" thick
  • Flat Jamb Bracket: 1-1/4" Wide
  • Finish: Silver Zinc
  • Packaged with #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws
  • PBB B7512 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)
  • PBB B7512 Installation Instructions (PDF)

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting hardware. Enough to do one door.
